title: Craft Barriers
description: This pack adds a crafting recipe for barriers to the game, along with an enchantment allowing your pickaxe to break them.
body:
![Minecraft title text. The top is red, saying craft barriers. The bottom is blue, saying abyssal vanguard.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83c49141d901145d8e177c8a7f95f146cd114fab.png)
## Craft Barrier
This datapack adds a crafting recipe for Barrier to the game. You're able to craft 16 pieces using Nether star, redstone block and glass. It also adds an enchantment which allows you to break bedrock, barriers and reinforced deepslate, at the cost of a chunk of your pickaxe's durability.

### Why This Matters
Unlock More Decoration: You can use barrier for a huge range of things, including decoration(trapping mobs or using it in place of string). It's a perfect addition to many builds.
Easy Nether Roof Access: The new enchantment makes it much easier to make an opening to the nether roof. Feel free to connect your portals without having to make complicated block breakers!
Multiplayer-Safe: The pack is lightweight and perfect for use in an SMP with your friends. Have fun making impenetrable defenses!

### Compatibility
Works with 1.21 and newer
Compatible with most datapacks and mods

This pack is perfect if you like to incorporate unobtainable blocks in a balanced way.

Made by MeowingChip5
